governingPremise: Once a physicalized replicator volume is large enough for a product, a sufficiently complete scan/pattern permits reproduction without recreating the product's conventional manufacturing chain.
antiRetconRule: Do not reintroduce conventional product-specific factories as necessities for goods inside a mature replicator's certified envelope unless an explicit physical, cultural, security, regulatory, throughput, state-domain, or scale reason is recorded.

conditions: object fits certified replication volume or has a certified segmented/continuous fabrication plan
pattern/scan resolves all physically relevant states needed for intended function
replicator supports the captured matter/state domain
sufficient matter/feedstock and energy are available

displacedDefaults: routine machining/casting/forming chains for known replicable goods
component assembly lines for known replicable goods
finished-goods warehousing where local replication is cheaper/faster
retainedFunctions: logistics of energy, feedstock, patterns and replication capacity

logistics.physicalInventoryShift: Routine spare diversity migrates from stocked physical parts to pattern libraries plus generalized feedstock.
logistics.criticalReadySpareRule: Critical hardware may remain physically stocked when replication/restoration latency exceeds allowed casualty response time.

propulsionTransitIntegration.rule: Replication changes drive fabrication and maintenance, not transit mathematics.
propulsionTransitIntegration.activeStateCaution: A replicated dormant drive does not automatically reproduce a live field, topology, Q-address, wormhole throat, bonded navigator, authenticated state, or external infrastructure.

generatorRules: Never infer replication capability solely from FTL Path, age, or narrative sophistication.
When replication exists, remove redundant conventional manufacturing requirements inside its certified envelope unless an explicit exception applies.
Preserve species and manufacturer technology-basis embodiment.
Record every source-specific replication limitation and its provenance.
Keep replication, understanding, commissioning, certification, and redesign as separate claims.
